# m.futures.exchanges

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Futures exchanges: the exchanges and trading venues of US futures.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.futures.exchanges(*, limit=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Id`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Exchanges (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Futures Basic | Updated as needed |
| Futures Starter | Updated as needed |
| Futures Developer | Updated as needed |
| Futures Advanced | Updated as needed |
| Futures Business CME | Updated as needed |
| Futures Business CBOT | Updated as needed |
| Futures Business NYMEX | Updated as needed |
| Futures Business COMEX | Updated as needed |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Acronym` | String | Well-known acronym for the exchange (e.g., 'CME', 'NYMEX', 'CBOT', 'COMEX'). |
| `Id` | String | Numeric identifier for the futures exchange or trading venue. |
| `Locale` | String | Geographic location code where the exchange operates. |
| `Mic` | String | Market Identifier Code (MIC) - ISO 10383 standard four-character code for the futures market. |
| `Name` | String | Full official name of the futures exchange (e.g., 'Chicago Mercantile Exchange', 'New York Mercantile Exchange'). |
| `OperatingMic` | String | Operating Market Identifier Code for the futures exchange. |
| `Type` | String | Type of venue - 'exchange' for futures exchanges and derivatives trading platforms. |
| `Url` | String | Official website URL of the futures exchange organization. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
